normal.zh_CN: 坂口医生，血压正在下降。
normal.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the blood pressure is falling.

normal.zh_CN: 血压比刚才低了，还在往下。
normal.en: The blood pressure is lower than before and still falling.

severe.en: The blood pressure is falling very quickly!

normal.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the blood pressure has risen.
The blood pressure is still rising.

severe.en: The blood pressure has suddenly risen sharply!

normal.zh_CN: 坂口医生，心率还在加快。
normal.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the heart rate is still increasing.

severe.en: The heart rate is rising rapidly!

normal.en: The heart rate is lower than before.

severe.en: The heart rate is still dropping rapidly!

normal.en: The rhythm is irregular, Doctor Sakaguchi.
The monitor shows a change in rhythm.

severe.en: The rhythm has suddenly become irregular!

normal.en: Oxygen saturation has started to fall.

normal.zh_CN: 坂口医生，血氧还在下降。
normal.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, oxygen saturation is still falling.

severe.en: Oxygen saturation is dropping very quickly!

normal.zh_CN: 呼吸情况和刚才不一样了。
normal.en: The respiratory status has changed since before.

normal.zh_CN: 坂口医生，监护状态有变化。
normal.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the monitoring readings have changed.
The patient's condition is becoming unstable.

severe.zh_CN: 患者状态突然不稳定了！
severe.en: The patient's condition has suddenly become unstable!

script_zh_CN.speaker: 米田栞
script_zh_CN.text: 天台比护士站安静很多呢。

script_zh_CN.speaker: 米田栞
script_zh_CN.text: 倒不是。我只是想把上午做过的事情，在心里再过一遍。

script_zh_CN.speaker: 米田栞
script_zh_CN.text: 留美姐姐问我周末想去哪儿。我本来差点说「姐姐决定就好」。

script_zh_CN.speaker: 米田栞
script_zh_CN.text: 我说我想去看书店的新书。她马上就答应了……其实没那么难开口嘛。

script_zh_CN.speaker: 米田栞
script_zh_CN.text: 今天有一份交接，是我自己从头核到尾的。

script_zh_CN.speaker: 米田栞
script_zh_CN.text: 有一点紧张。但确认完以后，我很想亲口告诉留美姐姐。
